description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me atraktive te periferise te Tiranes ofrojme per shitje kete prone e e cila pozicionohet ne nje kompleks rezidencial shume privat dhe me infrastrukture shume te mire. 
Aksesi i menjehershem dhe investimi i bere ne kete prone e bejne nje opoturnitet qe nuk duhet humbur si per qellim banim po ashtu edhe per qellim investimi. 
Prona ka nje siperfaqe trualli prej 407m2 dhe mbi kete siperfaqe eshte i ndertuar objekti me njolle prej 98m2.
Katin -1 ka nje siperfaqe prej 56m2 e cila sherben si vend parkimi per dy automjete, depo dhe nje ambient teknik. 
Kati 0 ka nje siperfaqe 98 m2 ku eshte organizuar ambienti i ndenjes, ambienti i gatimi dhe nje tualet + 27m2 verande dhe siperfaqen e oborrit. 
Kati 1 ka nje siperfaqe 100m2+ 21m2 ballkone e cila organizohet ne dy dhoma gjumi te cilat kane te inkorporuar tualet, garderobe dhe nje sdudio. 
Kati 2 ka nje siperfaqe 52 m2 e cila organizohet ne master bedroom, tualet, garderobe dhe nje verande me siperfaqe 52 m2. 
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. 
Na kontaktoni per te vizituar pronen.
description_en: In one of the most attractive areas of the outskirts of Tirana, we offer for sale this property, which is located in a very private residential complex with very good infrastructure. The immediate access and the investment made in this property make it an opportunity that should not be missed, both for residential purposes and for investment purposes. The property has a land surface of 407m2 and on this surface is built a building with a surface of 98m2. Floor -1 has a surface of 56m2 which serves as a parking space for two vehicles, a warehouse and a technical area. Floor 0 has an area of ​​98 m2 where the living room, the kitchen area and a toilet are organized + 27 m2 of veranda and the area of ​​the yard. The 1st floor has a surface area of ​​100m2 + 21m2 balcony, which is organized into two bedrooms, which have an incorporated toilet, wardrobe and a studio. The 2nd floor has an area of ​​52 m2, which is organized into a master bedroom, toilet, wardrobe and a veranda with an area of ​​52 m2. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Contact us to visit the property.
